title: Task 2 - Variable extraction item
description: Given a clause and the expected field names, the model returns a JSON map from field name to the value found in the clause. Scored field-level and leniently: numbers compared numerically, nested objects by component presence, text by case-insensitive containment.

id.description: Unique item id, of the form <template-name>-extract-01.

input.description: The clause text, with titles and headings stripped.

expected_output.description: Gold map from field name to value. Concerto framework metadata ($class, $identifier, clauseId) is removed and resource references are decoded to readable names, so extraction measures reading comprehension rather than knowledge of internal identifier formats.
